description: Extend lookahead into 2061b3's first 24 stationary epochs. Keep warps 0-3 on TMA/tcgen05 stationary work and split the remaining 28 into P8/C20 then P9/C19: producers update the next 16-column dependency frontier and factor/build the next NB16 panel into a double buffer while consumers apply the current panel to remaining near columns. Preserve the proven eight-phase tail and bracket balance with phase counters.

Implemented P8/C20 overlap across stationary panels 0:384. Warps 0-3 retain TMA/tcgen05 stationary work; warps 4-11 update the next NB16 dependency frontier, factor it, and build compact next-V/T after a named release from the stationary W phase; warps 12-31 update remaining near columns. The 32 KiB TMA operand is reused as compact next-V/Gram storage after tcgen05 consumption, then expanded into panel_v before the next TMA issue; T alternates between the existing panel_t/panel_gram slots and the eight-phase post-flush tail remains unchanged. Build succeeded and all 22 official tests, invariance, and off-grid guards passed, but the dense differential guard failed all 8/8 routed batch-640 inputs with scaled factor residuals around 2.7e3-2.9e3; mixed differential failed 2/8 inputs. No benchmark or profile ran because full validation failed. Graceful termination was requested before a fix trial.

Graceful termination was requested after the first P8/C20 implementation reached full validation. Parent 2061b37e1eb5eca837ec69786d4249f7a5cb5ec7 remains the only valid commit for this brief, with dense n512 15474.304 us and suite geomean 1424.026803. Commit 37aaf441428df82adcbb04577124e50659afb7c5 implements the requested stationary-era overlap: four TMA/tcgen05 warps, eight frontier/factor/build producers, twenty near-column consumers, compact next-V reuse of the released 32 KiB TMA stage, alternating T slots, and the unchanged eight-phase tail. It builds, passes all 22 official tests plus invariance and off-grid guards, but fails the routed dense differential guard on 8/8 inputs and mixed differential on 2/8, so it was logged validation_error with no metric and was not benchmarked or profiled. Concrete continuation points are to compare the first failing stationary epoch against the serial parent, verify the TMA-stage release/reuse handoff independently from alternating T, then bracket the requested P9/C19 balance after correctness is restored. No leaderboard submission was made.
